title: MZ's Better Ores
description: An improvement to the game's main ores
body:
![Better ores](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/933d5c76479e04ef85dd8a95e2d1e6c2aa521ecb.png)

**MZ's Better Ores** adds new functions to existing ores, among other new ores, to the game. It's worth remembering that the mod is in its first version and we intend to add many Vanilla features in the future.

We've now added **Enderite** ore, found in *The End*, which can make your tools extremely durable. Another notable ore is **Cryolite**, which, when smelted with other heatable materials, speeds up the smelting process.

Below, you can see the initial version of all the physical additions:

![Inicial ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/323c7d5c4f39b234b0870807ca9c42ca5259dab3.png)
